missing_arrival.protected: Missing LIRF rows with takeoff minus schedule >=24000 seconds retain complete v2 exactly

catboost_tail.gate: AOBT present AND (takeoff-AOBT<300 OR >2200 OR takeoff-EOBT>3600)

apply_order: seasonally routed CatBoost tail delta, then gate bounds
fixed-alpha missing-arrival raw delta, excluding protected tails
seasonally routed arrival-model delta, then known non-Rome gate bounds
delta_definition: For each known-row correction, replace column0 in the frozen v2 seasonal base, route using frozen experts and bounds, subtract the original seasonal base. Each delta is measured against the original base, not the preceding corrected prediction.
calibration: Even calendar dates in July/November 2025; odd dates and cross-month transfer are checks. Periods repeatedly reused for tuning, not unbiased tests.
rejected: Joint scalar fit that regressed November odd dates
